For the ambiguous round-1 case, I'm weighing whether the tightened rule (b) without slack would still catch it, or whether it depends on how close to turnaround the cube was and what first_cross_t equals—there's some risk here that I can't fully resolve. Round 2's case is clearer since the cube is far from its target, so it comfortably satisfies the new rules. Given the uncertainty, I'll accept the report's compromise: remaining <= 30, and timestep >= (2N-2)*first_cross_t with the slack removed.

The data from this round holds up consistently with that formulation, and I'm confirming that condition (b) simplifies to remaining <= first_cross_t. The round-2 refusal stemmed from the policy lacking visibility into the previous scene, which the new scene_frame field now resolves by giving the policy the frame directly — this doesn't invalidate round 2's original reasoning, it just supplements it. I'm deciding that scene_frame packaging the timestep, cube position, and target position as an ordered list is acceptable since it represents one coherent frame record, and since cube_side is now recoverable from that field, I'll drop it as redundant.

Now I need to work out the specific memory and policy edits: adding scene_frame, deleting cube_side, and modifying first_cross_t and crossings accordingly, along with revising the subgoal thresholds — changing the remaining-timestep conditions and adjusting the fallback value from 35 down to 30.

I'm adjusting the thresholds for the other quotes too, tightening the remaining-timestep cutoff to 30 and reframing the turnaround condition in terms of the scene timestep relative to (2N-2)*first_cross_t, while keeping the logic that C is chosen immediately once the cube is heading back or time is nearly up.

Now I'm revising the memory crossings policy: the carried-in cube side should instead reference the scene_frame's side based on comparing cube_x to target_x, and I'm replacing the first_cross_t estimation description with a new interpolation formula that still falls back to backward extrapolation when the flip occurs between decision steps.

I'm checking that nothing substantial was refused, just noting the round-1 near-turnaround edge case is only partially covered, then writing this out as JSON.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: - Choose C 'press button to stop the cube' if crossings == N-1 AND any of: (a) remaining <= 35 timesteps (the press takes roughly 25-30 timesteps to land); (b) remaining <= first_cross_t + 4 (the cube is at or past its predicted turnaround, which comes a quarter period before T_N); (c) the cube is HEADING BACK by the test above.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: - Choose C 'press button to stop the cube' if crossings == N-1 AND any of: (a) remaining <= 30 timesteps (the press takes roughly 25-30 timesteps to land); (b) the timestep of the scene at this decision step is at or past the predicted turnaround (2N-2)*first_cross_t, with no slack (equivalently remaining <= first_cross_t); (c) the cube is HEADING BACK by the test above.

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: with remaining > 35 and remaining > first_cross_t + 4 (including the step right after the (N-1)th crossing, however slowly the cube is gliding, and while it is still on its way out to the far end)
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: with remaining > 30 and the scene timestep still before the predicted turnaround (2N-2)*first_cross_t (including the step right after the (N-1)th crossing, however slowly the cube is gliding, and while it is still on its way out to the far end, even when only a few timesteps short of the turnaround)

policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: choose C immediately if the cube is HEADING BACK by the test above or remaining <= 35, otherwise B.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: choose C immediately if the cube is HEADING BACK by the test above or remaining <= 30, otherwise B.

policy_prompt_for_memory.description: Write the ordered list [timestep, cube_x, target_x] of the scene at this decision step (the last frame shown). Overwrite it every step; at the first step it is the t=0 frame. The side of the target line for any frame is smaller_x if cube_x < target_x, else larger_x; the carried-in scene_frame gives the side, timestep and positions of the last frame of the previous step, and is the frame before the flip whenever a crossing lies between the previous scene and this step's first frame. e.g. [56, 104, 117]

edits.modify_from: Build the sequence: the carried-in cube_side (skip if memory is empty),
edits.modify_to: Build the sequence: the side of the carried-in scene_frame (smaller_x if its cube_x < its target_x, else larger_x; skip if memory is empty),

edits.modify_from: find the first consecutive pair in this step's side sequence whose side differs. If both are frames of this step, write the timestep at which cube_x would equal target_x by linear interpolation between those two frames, rounded to the nearest whole timestep. If the flip is between the carried-in cube_side and this step's first frame, extrapolate backwards linearly from this step's first two frames (cube_x and timestep) to the timestep at which cube_x would equal target_x, and round.
edits.modify_to: find the first consecutive pair in this step's side sequence whose side differs; the earlier member is either the carried-in scene_frame or a frame of this step, the later member is a frame of this step. With t1, t2 their timesteps, d1 = cube_x - target_x at the earlier frame (its own target_x) and d2 likewise at the later frame, write t1 + (t2 - t1) * |d1| / (|d1| + |d2|), rounded half up to a whole timestep. Never extrapolate; the carried-in scene_frame always supplies the frame before a flip that precedes this step's first frame.

annotator_prompt.description: The scene at this decision step (the last frame shown), as the ordered list [t, cube_x, target_x]: its timestep, the cube's x-coordinate and the target's x-coordinate in that frame. Overwritten at every step; at step #1 it is read from the t=0 frame. The cube's side of the target line in that frame is the sign of cube_x minus target_x (smaller_x if negative, larger_x if positive), and the frame it records is the earlier member of the pair whenever the first crossing falls between the scene of one decision step and the first frame of the next. e.g. [56, 104, 117]

edits.modify_from: estimated by linear interpolation of cube_x against target_x between the last observed frame on the starting side and the first observed frame on the other side, rounded to the nearest whole timestep. If the flip lies between the scene of one decision step and the first frame of the next step, extrapolate backwards linearly from that next step's first two frames instead (the policy cannot see the earlier scene).
edits.modify_to: computed from the last observed frame on the starting side and the first observed frame on the other side (if the flip lies between the scene of one decision step and the first frame of the next, the earlier frame is that scene, as recorded in the carried-in scene_frame). With t1, t2 their timesteps, d1 = cube_x - target_x at the earlier frame (that frame's own target_x) and d2 likewise at the later frame: t_cross = t1 + (t2 - t1) * |d1| / (|d1| + |d2|), rounded half up to a whole timestep. No extrapolation is ever used.

revision.refused: Nothing in the report is withheld. The scene_frame field replaces the round-2 backward extrapolation, which was chosen only because the policy could not see the previous scene; now it carries that frame, so annotator and policy interpolate between the same two frames with the same formula, which does not undo the round-2 reasoning but removes its cause. cube_side is deleted because its value is recoverable from scene_frame at the same step, so it fails NECESSITY. The tightened press cutoffs (remaining <= 30, turnaround with no slack) are committed as reported; the round-1 case of a cube coasted to its far end and recorded C remains covered by (b) once the scene timestep reaches the predicted turnaround, by (c) if its x is identical in the last two frames, and by (a) in episodes with a quarter period of 30 or less, while the round-1 and round-2 refusals (no press merely because crossings reached N-1, no small-|v| turnaround test) stand.
